en.t: Emperor Valentinian II is assassinated while advancing into Gaul against the Frankish usurper Arbogast. He is found hanging in his residence at Vienne
en.s: Valentinian II (Latin: Valentinianus; 371 – 15 May 392) was a Roman emperor in the western part of the Roman Empire between AD 375 and 392. He was at first junior co-ruler of his half-brother, then was sidelined by a usurper, and finally became sole ruler after 388, albeit with limited de facto powers. He was the youngest emperor (co-ruler) in the Western Roman Empire (aged 4).

zh.t: 罗马皇帝瓦伦提尼安二世在进军高卢、对付法兰克篡位者阿波加斯特时遭暗杀，被发现吊死在维埃纳的住所中
zh.s: 瓦伦提尼安二世（拉丁语：Valentinianus；371年—392年5月15日）是公元375年至392年统治罗马帝国西部的皇帝。他起初与同父异母兄长共同执政，但后来被篡位者架空；388年后成为唯一统治者，不过实际权力有限。他是西罗马帝国最年轻的皇帝（共治皇帝），当时年仅4岁。

en.t: Constantine VII is crowned Byzantine co-emperor
en.s: Constantine VII Porphyrogenitus (Medieval Greek: Κωνσταντῖνος Πορφυρογέννητος, romanized: Kōnstantīnos Porphyrogénnētos; 17 May 905 – 9 November 959) was the fourth Byzantine emperor of the Macedonian dynasty, reigning from 6 June 913 to 9 November 959. He was the son of Emperor Leo VI and his fourth wife, Zoe Karbonopsina, and the nephew of his predecessor Alexander.

zh.t: 君士坦丁七世加冕为拜占庭共治皇帝
zh.s: 君士坦丁七世·波菲罗根尼图斯（中古希腊语：Κωνσταντῖνος Πορφυρογέννητος，转写：Kōnstantīnos Porphyrogénnētos；905年5月17日—959年11月9日）是马其顿王朝第四位拜占庭皇帝，统治时间为913年6月6日至959年11月9日。他是皇帝利奥六世与其第四任妻子佐伊·卡尔博诺普西娜之子，也是前任皇帝亚历山大的侄子。

en.s: The Battle of Chesterfield was a minor skirmish in the latter stages of 13th century England's Second Barons' War. It was part of the “mopping up” of Baronial opposition that resisted Henry III following the Battle of Evesham. The fighting took place in, and around, Chesterfield, Derbyshire on 15 May 1266.The leaders of the Barons were Robert Ferrers, Earl of Derby, Baldwin Wake, Lord of Chesterfield and John d’Ayville. The Royalist forces were led by Henry of Almain, nephew to Henry III. There are several references to aspects of the battle in chronicles from the period.

zh.s: 切斯特菲尔德战役是13世纪英格兰第二次男爵战争后期的一场小规模冲突。埃夫舍姆战役后，一些男爵仍抵抗亨利三世，王军随后清剿残余势力。1266年5月15日，双方在德比郡切斯特菲尔德及其周边交战。男爵一方由德比伯爵罗伯特·费勒斯、切斯特菲尔德领主鲍德温·韦克和约翰·达维尔率领；王军由亨利三世的侄子阿尔曼的亨利指挥。该战的多个细节见于当时的编年史。

en.s: The Battle of Hexham (15 May 1464) marked the end of significant Lancastrian resistance in the north of England during the early part of the reign of Edward IV. The battle was fought near the town of Hexham in Northumberland. John Neville, later to be 1st Marquess of Montagu, led a modest force of 3,000-4,000 men, routed the rebel Lancastrians. Most of the rebel leaders were captured and executed, including Henry Beaufort, Duke of Somerset and Lord Hungerford. Henry VI, however, was kept safely away (having been captured in battle 3 times earlier in his life), and escaped to the north.

zh.s: 1464年5月15日的赫克瑟姆战役，标志着爱德华四世统治初期兰开斯特派在英格兰北部的大规模抵抗基本结束。战斗发生在诺森伯兰郡赫克瑟姆镇附近。约翰·内维尔（后来的蒙塔古侯爵）率领一支约3000至4000人的部队，击溃兰开斯特派叛军。亨利·博福特（萨默塞特公爵）和亨格福德勋爵等大多数叛军首领被俘并处决。亨利六世当时被安置在远处，没有参战，随后逃往北方；此前他曾三次在战斗中被俘。

en.s: The siege of London was an episode of the Wars of the Roses between 12 and 15 May 1471, in which adherents of the House of Lancaster commanded by Thomas Neville unsuccessfully attempted to storm the city and free King Henry VI, who had been imprisoned in the Tower of London by his rival Edward IV of the House of York.

zh.s: 伦敦围城战是玫瑰战争期间的一场战事，发生于1471年5月12日至15日。兰开斯特家族支持者在托马斯·内维尔率领下试图攻入伦敦，救出被约克家族的爱德华四世关押在伦敦塔中的亨利六世，但未能成功。

en.s: The Battle of Frankenhausen was fought on 15 May 1525. It was the final act of the German Peasants' War: joint troops of Landgrave Philip I of Hesse and Duke George of Saxony defeated the peasants under their leader Thomas Müntzer near Frankenhausen in the County of Schwarzburg. On April 29, 1525, the struggles in and around Frankenhausen had culminated into an open revolt. Large parts of the citizenry joined the uprising, occupied the town hall and stormed the castle of the Counts of Schwarzburg.

zh.s: 弗兰肯豪森战役于1525年5月15日爆发，是德国农民战争的最后一场大战。黑森伯爵腓力一世和萨克森公爵格奥尔格的联军，在施瓦茨堡伯国的弗兰肯豪森附近击败了托马斯·闵采尔率领的农民军。4月29日，弗兰肯豪森及周边地区的冲突发展成公开起义。当地许多居民加入起义，占领市政厅并冲进施瓦茨堡伯爵的城堡。

en.t: The English church submits to the king of England in passing a convocation in which it surrenders a number of rights, such as to make provincial ecclesiastic laws independently of the king
en.s: The Church of England (C of E) is the established Christian church in England and the Crown Dependencies. It was the initial church of the Anglican tradition. The church traces its history to the Christian hierarchy recorded as existing in the Roman province of Britain by the 3rd century and to the 6th-century Gregorian mission to Kent led by Augustine of Canterbury. Its members are called Anglicans.

zh.t: 英格兰教会通过召集会议向英王屈服，放弃多项权利
zh.s: 英格兰教会（C of E）是英格兰和王室属地的国教，也是圣公宗传统的源头。其历史可追溯至公元3世纪罗马不列颠行省的基督教教阶，以及6世纪奥古斯丁赴肯特传教。其信徒称为圣公宗教徒。

en.t: Venice, Spain, Naples, the Papal States, and other Italian states establish the Holy League to fight the Ottomans, resulting in the victory at Lepanto later that year
en.s: The Papal States ( PAY-pəl), officially the State of the Church, were a conglomeration of territories on the Italian Peninsula under the direct sovereign rule of the pope from 756 to 1870. They were among the major Italian states from the 8th century until the unification of Italy, which took place between 1859 and 1870, culminating in their incorporation into the Kingdom of Italy.

zh.t: 威尼斯、西班牙、那不勒斯、教皇国及其他意大利邦国组成神圣同盟对抗奥斯曼帝国，并于当年在勒班陀获胜
zh.s: 教皇国正式名称为教会国，是756年至1870年间位于意大利半岛、由教皇直接统治的一组领土。自8世纪起，它一直是重要的意大利邦国之一，直至1859年至1870年意大利统一，并最终并入意大利王国。

en.s: The Tranquebar Rebellion (Danish: Trankebar oprøret), also known as the Tranquebar Mutiny (Danish: Trankebar opstanden), was a bloodless mutiny and uprising against the governor of Tranquebar, Willem Leyel, at Tranquebar in 1648. The mutineers succeeded in arresting Leyel, and he would be replaced by the leader of the rebellion, Poul Hansen Korsør.

zh.s: 丹麦塞兰坡叛乱（丹麦语：Trankebar oprøret），又称丹麦塞兰坡兵变（丹麦语：Trankebar opstanden），是1648年在丹麦塞兰坡发生的一场不流血兵变和起义，目标是推翻总督威廉·莱尔。兵变者成功逮捕莱尔，随后由起义领袖保尔·汉森·科瑟尔接替他担任总督。

en.s: The Battle of Perast (Serbian: Перашка битка) was a battle for control over Venetian held Perast (modern day Montenegro) fought in 1654 between defending forces of Venetian Republic from Perast accompanied by hajduks and attacking forces of Ottoman Empire from Sanjak of Herzegovina. Commander of defending Perast forces was Krsto Vicković while Ottoman forces were led by Dizdar Mehmed Rizvanbegović.

zh.s: 佩拉斯特战役（塞尔维亚语：Перашка битка）是1654年争夺佩拉斯特控制权的一场战斗。当时佩拉斯特由威尼斯共和国控制，位于今黑山。防守方是佩拉斯特的威尼斯军队及哈伊杜克武装，进攻方是来自奥斯曼帝国赫塞哥维纳桑贾克的军队。防守方指挥官为克尔斯托·维奇科维奇，奥斯曼军队由迪兹达尔·穆罕默德·里兹万贝戈维奇率领。

en.t: Bach led the first performance of his cantata Ich bin ein guter Hirt, BWV 85, about Jesus as the Good Shepherd
en.s: Ich bin ein guter Hirt (I am a Good Shepherd), BWV 85, is a church cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach. He composed it in Leipzig for the second Sunday after Easter and first performed it on 15 April 1725. He wrote the cantata in the second calendar year of his tenure as Thomaskantor that began in May 1723, but he assigned it to his third cantata cycle.

zh.t: 巴赫首次指挥演出康塔塔《我是良善的牧人》，讲述耶稣是好牧人
zh.s: 《我是良善的牧人》（Ich bin ein guter Hirt，BWV 85）是约翰·塞巴斯蒂安·巴赫创作的一首教会康塔塔。巴赫为复活节后第二个星期日的礼拜在莱比锡创作了这部作品，并于1725年4月15日首演。创作时他担任圣托马斯教堂乐长已进入第二个日历年，但将作品列入第三套康塔塔周期。

en.s: The French conquest of Corsica was a successful expedition by French forces of the Kingdom of France under the Comte de Vaux, against Corsican forces under Pasquale Paoli of the Corsican Republic. The expedition was launched in May 1768, in the aftermath of the Seven Years' War. A French expeditionary force was landed on the island of Corsica, then ruled by the Corsican Republic.

zh.s: 法国征服科西嘉是法国王国军队在德沃伯爵率领下，针对帕斯夸莱·保利领导的科西嘉共和国军队发动的一次成功远征。七年战争结束后，法国于1768年5月发动这次远征，并向当时由科西嘉共和国统治的科西嘉岛派遣远征军。

en.s: Battle of Dęborzyn - a battle fought on 15 May 1770, during the Bar Confederation in the area of the village of Dęborzyn near Pilzno. The battle took place during a sortie towards Tarnów, carried out by Kazimierz Pułaski at the head of a cavalry unit of 1,200 people. The Confederation took up positions near Dęborzyn, on a hill to which the road led through the ravine.

zh.s: 登博日恩战役于1770年5月15日爆发，是巴尔联盟战争期间发生在皮尔兹诺附近的一场战斗。卡齐米日·普瓦斯基率领1200名骑兵向塔尔努夫方向出击，双方在登博日恩附近交战。巴尔联盟军占据村边一座山丘上的阵地，道路要经峡谷才能通往那里。

en.s: Battle of Rusçuk, was one of the battles of the Russo-Turkish War (1768–1774). The Russian army under the command of Colonel N. P. Repnin was defeated by the Ottoman army under the command of Ali Pasha near Ruse on May 15, 1773.

zh.s: 鲁塞克战役是1768—1774年俄土战争中的一场战斗。1773年5月15日，尼·彼·列普宁上校率领的俄军在鲁塞附近被阿里帕夏指挥的奥斯曼军队击败。

en.s: The battle of Fredrikshamn was an attack by the Swedish archipelago fleet on their Russian counterparts near the town of Fredrikshamn (Hamina) during the Russo-Swedish War (1788–1790).

zh.s: 1788年至1790年俄瑞战争期间，瑞典群岛舰队在腓特烈港（今芬兰哈米纳）附近攻击俄国舰队。

en.s: The Battle of Skellefteå took place during the Finnish War, on 15 May 1809, when 6,000 Russians under Pavel Andreyevich Shuvalov attacked 700 Swedes under Johan Henrik Furumark, at Skellefteå, Sweden. The Swedes, who fought a delaying action to buy time for their provisions to be escorted to safety, were captured as the Russians flanked around and cut-off their way of retreat. Most provisions, however, were saved.

zh.s: 谢莱夫特奥战役于1809年5月15日在芬兰战争期间爆发。帕维尔·安德烈耶维奇·舒瓦洛夫率领6000名俄军进攻约翰·亨里克·富鲁马克率领的700名瑞典军，地点在瑞典谢莱夫特奥。瑞典军为争取时间，将补给护送到安全处而进行迟滞作战，俄军则从侧翼包抄并切断其退路，随后俘获瑞典军。大部分补给最终得以保全。

en.s: The battle of San Carlos occurred on 15 May 1813, during the War of Chilean Independence.

zh.s: 圣卡洛斯战役于1813年5月15日在智利独立战争期间爆发。

en.s: The Shipwreck of Dellys took place in May 1830, during the French conquest of Algeria. It involved French troupes coloniales, under captains Félix-Ariel d'Assigny (1794–1846) and Armand Joseph Bruat (1796–1855), who were captured by armed Bedouins of the town of Dellys.

zh.s: 代利斯海难发生于1830年5月法国征服阿尔及利亚期间。法国殖民军由菲利克斯-阿里埃尔·达西尼上尉（1794—1846）和阿尔芒·约瑟夫·布吕阿上尉（1796—1855）率领，后被代利斯镇的贝都因武装人员俘获。

en.s: The Sicilian revolution of 1848 was the first of the numerous Revolutions of 1848 which swept across Europe. It was a popular rebellion against the rule of Ferdinand II of the House of Bourbon, King of the Two Sicilies. Three revolutions against the Bourbon ruled Kingdom of the Two Sicilies had previously occurred on the island of Sicily starting from 1800: this final one, which commenced on 12 January 1848, resulted in an independent state (the self-proclaimed Kingdom of Sicily) which survived for 16 months.

zh.s: 1848年西西里革命是席卷欧洲的1848年革命浪潮中的第一场。起义民众反抗两西西里王国波旁王朝国王斐迪南二世的统治。此前，西西里岛上从1800年起已发生三次反对波旁王朝的革命。最后一场革命于1848年1月12日爆发，建立了自行宣布成立的西西里王国；这个独立国家存续了16个月。

en.s: The Arana–Southern Treaty (Spanish: Tratado Arana-Southern) or Convention of Settlement, formally known as the Convention for the perfect restoration of friendly relations between the Argentine Confederation and Her Britannic Majesty, was a peace treaty signed between the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland and the Argentine Confederation following the Anglo-French blockade of the Río de la Plata.
en.n: The Arana–Southern Treaty is ratified, ending "the existing differences" between Great Britain and Argentina.

zh.s: 阿拉纳—索森条约（西班牙语：Tratado Arana-Southern），又称《和解公约》，正式名称为《关于阿根廷邦联与不列颠女王陛下之间全面恢复友好关系的公约》。这是英国与阿根廷邦联签署的一项和平条约，旨在结束英国和法国对拉普拉塔河的封锁后双方的争端。
zh.n: 该条约获批准，结束英国与阿根廷之间“现存的分歧”。

en.s: The Battle of Calatafimi was fought on May 15, 1860 between Giuseppe Garibaldi's volunteers and the troops of the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies at Calatafimi, Sicily, as part of the Expedition of the Thousand (Italian: I Mille).

zh.s: 卡拉塔菲米战役于1860年5月15日在西西里岛卡拉塔菲米爆发，交战双方是朱塞佩·加里波第的志愿军和两西西里王国的军队。此战是“千人远征”（意大利语：I Mille）的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Jiangnan, also known as the Second Rout of the Jiangnan Battalion (Chinese: 太平軍二破江南大營) took place in 1860 between the Qing dynasty's Green Standard Army and the army of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom during the Taiping Rebellion. The Green Standard Army twice attempted to besiege Nanjing, capital of the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom, but was unable to break through.

zh.s: 江南战役又称太平军二破江南大营（中文：太平軍二破江南大營），是1860年太平天国运动期间，清朝绿营与太平天国军队之间的一场战斗。绿营曾两次围攻太平天国首都南京，但都未能攻破。

en.s: The Battle of Drewry's Bluff, also known as the Battle of Fort Darling, or Fort Drewry, took place on May 15, 1862, in Chesterfield County, Virginia, as part of the Peninsula Campaign of the American Civil War. Five Union Navy warships, including the ironclads USS Monitor and Galena, steamed up the James River to test the defenses of Richmond, Virginia, the Confederate capital. They encountered submerged obstacles and deadly accurate fire from the batteries of Fort Darling at Drewry's Bluff, which inflicted severe damage on Galena. The Union Navy was forced to turn back.

zh.s: 德鲁里崖战役又称达令堡战役或德鲁里堡战役，于1862年5月15日在弗吉尼亚州切斯特菲尔德县爆发，是美国南北战争半岛战役的一部分。包括铁甲舰“莫尼特号”和“加利纳号”在内的5艘联邦海军军舰沿詹姆斯河驶向里士满，试图侦察这座邦联首都的防御。舰队遭遇水下障碍，并受到德鲁里崖达令堡炮台的精准火力攻击，“加利纳号”严重受损，联邦海军被迫撤回。

en.s: The Battle of Cayawal (also known as Tyayafal or Thiayewal) was a six day long battle between forces of the Umarian State (Toucouleur Empire) and the Massina Empire (Caliphate of Hamdullahi). It pitted the invading Umarian army of Omar Tall against those of Amadu III. The battle was a crushing victory for Umarian forces, leading to the disintegration of the Massina Empire a month later.

zh.s: 卡亚瓦尔战役又称泰亚法尔战役，交战双方是乌马尔国家（图库勒尔帝国）与马西纳帝国（哈穆达拉希哈里发国），战事持续六天。乌马尔军由奥马尔·塔尔率领入侵，迎战阿马杜三世的部队。乌马尔军大获全胜，马西纳帝国在一个月后瓦解。

en.s: The Battle of New Market was a battle fought on May 15, 1864, in Virginia during Valley Campaigns of 1864 in the American Civil War. A makeshift Confederate army of 4100 men, which included cadets from the Virginia Military Institute (VMI), forced Union Major General Franz Sigel and his army out of the Shenandoah Valley.

zh.s: 新市场战役于1864年5月15日在弗吉尼亚州爆发，是美国内战期间1864年谢南多厄河谷战役的一部分。一支临时组建的邦联军队有4100人，其中包括弗吉尼亚军事学院（VMI）的学员。他们迫使联邦军少将弗朗茨·西格尔及其部队撤出谢南多厄河谷。

en.s: The Battle of Montecristi (Spanish: Batalla de Montecristi) was fought on May 15, 1864 in the Captaincy General of Santo Domingo, during the Dominican Restoration War (1863–65) between Dominican forces and Spain. A Spanish force of 6,000 troops with 13 cannons, commanded by Captain-General José de la Gándara, sailed from Santiago de Cuba to Manzanillo Bay and attacked Dominican insurgents led by Benito Monción in the town of Monte Cristi.

zh.s: 蒙特克里斯蒂战役（西班牙语：Batalla de Montecristi）于1864年5月15日在圣多明各都督辖区爆发，是多米尼加复国战争（1863—1865）期间多米尼加军队与西班牙军队之间的一场战斗。西班牙都督何塞·德拉甘达上将率领6000名士兵和13门火炮，从古巴圣地亚哥驶往曼萨尼约湾，随后进攻由贝尼托·蒙西翁率领、驻守蒙特克里斯蒂镇的多米尼加起义军。

en.s: The siege of Querétaro was the culminating battle of the Second French intervention in Mexico and the Second Mexican Empire. It took place between Republican and Imperial armies from 6 March to 15 May 1867. After the French departed, the remaining Imperial forces were concentrated in the center of the country. Emperor Maximilian decided to head to the city of Querétaro, while a remaining force was left at the capital.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克雷塔罗围城战是第二次法国干涉墨西哥和第二墨西哥帝国时期的最后一场关键战役。共和军与帝国军于1867年3月6日至5月15日在此交战。法军撤离后，帝国军残部集中在墨西哥中部。马克西米利安皇帝决定前往克雷塔罗市，另有一支部队留守首都。

en.s: The Capture of Touggourt was a military operation carried out by the Chaamba tribe against the city of Touggourt during the Mokrani Revolt, in which the French garrison of the city and its commander were massacred. It occurred from May 14–15, 1871.

zh.s: 图古尔特城陷落是昌巴部族在莫克拉尼起义期间对图古尔特城发动的一次军事行动，城内法军驻军及其指挥官遭到屠杀。行动发生于1871年5月14日至15日。

en.t: Establishment of the Tokyo Stock Exchange
en.s: The Tokyo Stock Exchange (東京証券取引所, Tōkyō Shōken Torihikijo), abbreviated as Tosho (東証) or TSE/TYO, is a stock exchange located in Tokyo, Japan. The exchange is owned by Japan Exchange Group (JPX), a holding company that it also lists (TYO: 8697), and operated by Tokyo Stock Exchange, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of JPX.

zh.s: 东京证券交易所（日语：東京証券取引所，Tōkyō Shōken Torihikijo），简称东证或TSE/TYO，位于日本东京。交易所由日本交易所集团（JPX）持有；该控股公司也在交易所上市（TYO：8697）。东京证券交易所股份有限公司是JPX全资子公司，负责运营交易所。

en.s: The Eiffel Tower ( EYE-fəl; French: Tour Eiffel [tuʁ ɛfɛl] ) is a lattice tower on the Champ de Mars in Paris, France. It is named after the engineer Gustave Eiffel, whose company designed and built the tower from 1887 to 1889. Locally nicknamed "La dame de fer" (French for "Iron Lady") for its use of wrought iron, it was constructed as the centrepiece of the 1889 World's Fair, and to crown the centennial anniversary of the French Revolution.

zh.s: 埃菲尔铁塔（法语：Tour Eiffel，[tuʁ ɛfɛl]）是一座位于法国巴黎战神广场的格构塔，以工程师居斯塔夫·埃菲尔命名，其公司于1887年至1889年间设计并建造了这座塔。铁塔以熟铁建造，当地昵称为“铁娘子”（La dame de fer）。它是1889年世界博览会的中心建筑，并用于纪念法国大革命一百周年。

en.s: The Amapá Question, known in France as the Franco-Brazilian Dispute (French: Contesté franco-brésilien) was a 1895 border dispute involving France and Brazil. The French intrusion into Amapá resulted in skirmishes between the two sides.

zh.s: 阿马帕问题在法国被称为法巴争端（法语：Contesté franco-brésilien），是1895年法国与巴西之间的边界争端。法国侵入阿马帕地区后，双方发生了小规模冲突。

en.s: The 1902 Copa de la Coronación final was the final of the Copa de la Coronación, the Spanish football cup competition. The match took place on 15 May 1902 at the Hipódromo in Madrid. The match was contested by Club Bizcaya and FC Barcelona, and it was refereed by Carlos Padrós. Club Bizcaya lifted the trophy for the first time with a 2–1 victory over FC Barcelona.

zh.s: 1902年加冕杯决赛是西班牙足球杯赛加冕杯的决赛。比赛于1902年5月15日在马德里的希波德罗莫球场举行，由比斯开俱乐部对阵巴塞罗那足球俱乐部，裁判为卡洛斯·帕德罗斯。比斯开俱乐部以2比1击败巴塞罗那，首次捧起奖杯。

en.s: Las Vegas, colloquially shortened to Vegas, is the most populous city in the U.S. state of Nevada and the county seat of Clark County. It is the 24th-most populous city in the United States, with 641,903 residents at the 2020 census. The Las Vegas metropolitan area has an estimated 2.4 million residents and is the 29th-largest metropolitan area in the country.

zh.s: 拉斯维加斯常简称为维加斯，是美国内华达州人口最多的城市，也是克拉克县县治。根据2020年人口普查，该市有641,903名居民，是美国人口第24多的城市。拉斯维加斯都会区估计有240万居民，是全美第29大都会区。

en.s: The Dulwich by-election, 1906 was a by-election held on 15 May 1906 for the British House of Commons constituency of Dulwich in South London. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of the serving Conservative Party Member of Parliament (MP), Dr Frederick Rutherfoord Harris, who was moving back to South Africa where he had previously lived for many years. The Unionist candidate was Andrew Bonar Law, former Parliamentary Secretary to the Board of Trade who had lost his seat in the Liberal landslide in the February general election. The Liberal Party candidate was David Williamson, who had also contested the February election.

zh.s: 1906年德威奇补选于5月15日举行，选出英国下议院南伦敦德威奇选区的议员。补选由保守党现任议员弗雷德里克·鲁瑟福德·哈里斯博士辞职引发，他此前在南非生活多年，此时准备搬回那里。统一党候选人是安德鲁·博纳·劳；他曾任贸易委员会议会秘书，并在同年2月自由党大胜的全国大选中失去席位。自由党候选人大卫·威廉森也参加了2月的大选。

en.s: The 1910 association football match between the national teams of Italy and France was the first ever official match played by Italy. The match took place on 15 May 1910 at the Arena Civica in Milan. Officiated by Harry Goodley, the match was watched by about 4,000 spectators and ended in a 6–2 home win for Italy. Italy's Pietro Lana scored the first goal of the match, and of Italy's history.

zh.s: 1910年5月15日，意大利和法国国家队在米兰的市民竞技场举行足球赛。这是意大利国家队参加的首场正式比赛。比赛由哈里·古德利执法，约4000名观众现场观看，意大利主场以6比2获胜。意大利球员彼得罗·拉纳打入本场首球，也是意大利国家队历史上的首粒进球。

en.s: The Torreón massacre (Spanish: Matanza de chinos de Torreón; Chinese: 萊苑慘案) was a massacre that took place from May 13 to May 15, 1911 in the Mexican city of Torreón, Coahuila. A total of 308 Chinese were killed, amounting to half the Chinese community in Torreón. The victims, accused of collusion with dictator Porfirio Díaz, were killed by a local mob and the revolutionary forces of Francisco I.
en.n: More than 300 Chinese immigrants are killed in the Torreón massacre when the forces of the Mexican Revolution led by Emilio Madero take the city of Torreón from the Federales.

zh.s: 托雷翁大屠杀发生于 1911 年 5 月 13 日至 15 日，地点是墨西哥科阿韦拉州托雷翁市。共有 308 名华人遇害，约占当地华人社区的一半。受害者被指控与独裁者波菲里奥·迪亚斯勾结，随后遭当地暴民和弗朗西斯科·I·马德罗领导的革命力量杀害。大量华人住宅和商店遭到洗劫和毁坏。
zh.n: 墨西哥革命军在埃米利奥·马德罗率领下攻占托雷翁时，300 多名华人移民在大屠杀中遇害。

en.t: Standard Oil Co. of New Jersey v. United States
en.s: Standard Oil Co. of New Jersey v. United States, 221 U.S. 1 (1911), was a landmark U.S. Supreme Court decision that ruled that John D. Rockefeller's petroleum conglomerate Standard Oil had illegally monopolized the American petroleum industry and ordered the company to break itself up. The decision also held, however, that U.S. antitrust law bans only "unreasonable" restraints on trade, an interpretation that came to be known as the "rule of reason".
en.n: This entry records the decision, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.t: 新泽西标准石油公司诉美国案
zh.s: “新泽西标准石油公司诉美国案”（221 U.S. 1，1911年）是美国最高法院的一项里程碑式判决。法院裁定，约翰·D·洛克菲勒的石油企业标准石油公司非法垄断美国石油业，并下令将公司拆分。不过，判决也认为，美国反垄断法只禁止对贸易造成“不合理”限制的行为。这一解释后来被称为“合理原则”。

en.s: The 1912 Quebec general election was held on May 15, 1912, to elect members of the 13th Legislative Assembly of the Province of Quebec, Canada. The incumbent Quebec Liberal Party, led by Lomer Gouin, was re-elected, defeating the Quebec Conservative Party, led by Joseph-Mathias Tellier.

zh.s: 加拿大魁北克省于1912年5月15日举行大选，选出第13届省议会议员。由洛梅尔·关领导的魁北克自由党再次当选执政党，击败了由约瑟夫-马蒂亚斯·泰利耶领导的魁北克保守党。

en.s: Battle of Sieniawa (Russian: Битва под Синявами); The operation of the Russian army during the offensive of the central powers in Galicia. The operation was carried out in order to divert the attention of the Austro-Hungarian command from Przemysl, which was under threat of capture, despite a decisive tactical victory and a large advance deep into the territory, it was not possible to distract the enemy's attention.

zh.s: 西尼亚瓦战役（俄语：Битва под Синявами）是中央同盟国在加利西亚发动攻势期间，俄军实施的一次军事行动。行动旨在转移奥匈军队的注意力，以减轻普热梅希尔面临的陷落威胁。尽管俄军取得决定性的战术胜利并深入敌方领土，仍未能转移敌军注意力。

en.t: Battle of the Strait of Otranto (1917)
en.s: The Battle of the Strait of Otranto of 1917 was the result of an Austro-Hungarian raid during the Adriatic Campaign of World War I on the Otranto Barrage, an Allied naval blockade of the Strait of Otranto. The battle took place on 15 May 1917, and was the largest surface action in the Adriatic Sea during World War I.

zh.s: 1917年奥特朗托海峡海战源于奥匈帝国在第一次世界大战亚得里亚海战役期间突袭协约国的奥特朗托水道封锁线。战斗于1917年5月15日爆发，是第一次世界大战期间亚得里亚海规模最大的一场水面舰艇交战。

en.s: Finland saw significant political violence from the end of the Finnish Civil War until the Mäntsälä rebellion. The Red Guerrilla Battalion of the North under the Communist Party of Finland, would fight Finnish border guards during the Pork Mutiny. Minister Heikki Ritavuori would be shot dead at the door to his home in Helsinki in February 1922. In 1923, many members of the Socialist Workers' Party of Finland would be arrested.

zh.s: 从芬兰内战结束到曼察莱叛乱期间，芬兰发生了严重的政治暴力事件。芬兰共产党旗下的北方红色游击营曾在波尔克兵变期间与芬兰边防军交战。1922年2月，部长海基·里塔沃里在赫尔辛基住所门口遭枪杀。1923年，芬兰社会主义工人党许多成员被捕。

en.t: The Finnish Civil War ends when the Whites take over Fort Ino, a Russian coastal artillery base on the Karelian Isthmus, from Russian troops
en.s: The Finnish Civil War was fought in 1918 for the leadership and control of recently independent Finland (formerly part of Russia) between White Finland and the Finnish Socialist Workers' Republic (Red Finland). The clashes took place in the context of the national, political, and social turmoil caused by World War I (Eastern Front) in Europe.

zh.t: 白军攻占俄军驻守的伊诺要塞，芬兰内战结束
zh.s: 芬兰内战发生于1918年，交战双方为白色芬兰和芬兰社会主义工人共和国（红色芬兰），争夺新近独立的芬兰（此前属于俄罗斯）的领导权和控制权。战事发生在第一次世界大战（东线）引发的欧洲国家、政治和社会动荡背景下。

en.s: The city of Smyrna (modern-day İzmir) and surrounding areas were under Greek military occupation from 15 May 1919 until 9 September 1922. The Allied Powers authorized the occupation and creation of the Zone of Smyrna (Greek: Ζώνη Σμύρνης, romanized: Zóni Smýrnis) during negotiations regarding the partition of the Ottoman Empire to protect the ethnic Greek population living in and around the city.

zh.s: 希腊军队于1919年5月15日至1922年9月9日占领士麦那（今土耳其伊兹密尔）及周边地区。协约国在讨论瓜分奥斯曼帝国时批准占领并设立士麦那区（希腊语：Ζώνη Σμύρνης，转写：Zóni Smýrnis），目的是保护当地及周边的希腊族居民。

en.s: The Greco-Turkish War of 1919–1922 was fought between Greece and the Turkish National Movement during the partitioning of the Ottoman Empire in the aftermath of World War I, between 15 May 1919 and 14 October 1922. This conflict was a part of the Turkish War of Independence. The causes and aims of the war have been debated and interpreted differently in the historiography.

zh.s: 希土战争于1919年5月15日至1922年10月14日进行，交战双方是希腊和土耳其民族运动。战争发生在第一次世界大战后奥斯曼帝国被瓜分期间，也是土耳其独立战争的一部分。历史研究对战争的原因和目标有不同的讨论和解释。

en.s: The Turkish War of Independence (15 May 1919 – 24 July 1923) was a series of military campaigns and a revolution waged by the Turkish National Movement, after the Ottoman Empire was occupied and partitioned following its defeat in World War I. The conflict was between the Turkish Nationalists against Allied and separatist forces over the application of Wilsonian principles, especially self-determination, in post-World War I Anatolia and eastern Thrace.

zh.s: 土耳其独立战争于1919年5月15日至1923年7月24日进行，是奥斯曼帝国在一战战败并遭占领、瓜分后，土耳其民族运动发动的一系列军事行动和革命。土耳其民族主义者与协约国及分离主义势力交战，争议焦点包括一战后在安纳托利亚和东色雷斯落实威尔逊原则，尤其是民族自决原则。

en.s: The Winnipeg General Strike of 1919 was one of the most dramatic and influential strikes in Canadian history. For six weeks, May 15 to June 26, more than 30,000 strikers brought economic activity to a standstill in Winnipeg, Manitoba, which at the time was Canada's third largest city. In the short term, the strike ended in arrests and bloodshed.
en.n: The Winnipeg general strike begins. By 11:00, almost the whole working population of Winnipeg had walked off the job.

zh.s: 1919年温尼伯总罢工是加拿大历史上影响深远、场面激烈的罢工之一。罢工从5月15日持续到6月26日，为期六周。超过3万名罢工者使当时加拿大第三大城市、马尼托巴省温尼伯的经济活动陷入停顿。短期来看，罢工以逮捕和流血事件告终。
zh.n: 温尼伯总罢工开始。到上午11时，温尼伯几乎所有劳动者都已离开工作岗位。

en.s: The Greek landing at Smyrna (Greek: Ελληνική απόβαση στη Σμύρνη; Turkish: Yunanların İzmir'e çıkışı) was a military operation by Greek forces starting on May 15, 1919 which involved landing troops in the city of Smyrna and surrounding areas. The landing was sanctioned by British Prime Minister David Lloyd George, who argued that: "[a] massacre is taking place over there and there is nobody to protect the Greek population".

zh.s: 希腊军队于1919年5月15日开始在士麦那（希腊语：Ελληνική απόβαση στη Σμύρνη；土耳其语：Yunanların İzmir'e çıkışı）登陆，并占领该城及周边地区。这项军事行动得到英国首相戴维·劳合·乔治的支持。他称：“那里正在发生屠杀，却没有人保护希腊居民。”

en.s: The 1920 FA Charity Shield was a football match played on 15 May 1920 between the winners of the two divisions of the Football League in 1919–20. It was the seventh FA Charity Shield match and was contested by First Division champions West Bromwich Albion and Second Division champions Tottenham Hotspur. The match was played at Tottenham's home ground, White Hart Lane.

zh.s: 1920年英格兰足总慈善盾赛于1920年5月15日举行，由1919—1920赛季英格兰足球联赛两个级别的冠军对阵。这是第七届慈善盾赛，参赛双方是甲级联赛冠军西布罗姆维奇和乙级联赛冠军托特纳姆热刺。比赛在热刺主场白鹿巷球场举行。

en.s: General elections were held in Italy on 15 May 1921. It was the first election in which the recently acquired regions of Trentino-Alto Adige, Venezia Giulia, Zara and Lagosta island elected deputies, many of whom from Germanic and South Slav ethnicity.

zh.s: 意大利于1921年5月15日举行大选。这是新近并入意大利的特伦蒂诺-上阿迪杰、朱利安边区、扎拉和拉戈斯塔岛首次选出议员参加选举；其中许多议员来自日耳曼族和南斯拉夫族群。

en.s: The 1927 Copa del Rey final was the 27th final of the Spanish cup competition, the Copa del Rey. The final was played at Torrero, in Zaragoza, on 15 May 1927. Real Unión beat Arenas Club de Getxo 1–0 and won their third and last title (fourth title counting the trophy won by Racing de Irun in 1913). The only goal of the match was scored in extra-time by José Echeveste.

zh.s: 1927年西班牙国王杯决赛是该项赛事的第27届决赛。比赛于1927年5月15日在萨拉戈萨的托雷罗球场举行。皇家联合队以1比0击败赫塔费竞技俱乐部，赢得队史第三个、也是最后一个冠军；若算上1913年伊伦竞技队赢得的奖杯，则是第四个。何塞·埃切维斯特在加时赛打进全场唯一一球。

en.s: The 1928 New Jersey Republican presidential primary was held on May 15, 1928, in New Jersey as one of the Republican Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1928 United States presidential election. Delegates to the 1928 Republican National Convention were elected from each of the state's congressional districts, along with seven delegates at-large.

zh.t: 1928年新泽西州共和党总统初选
zh.s: 1928年新泽西州共和党总统初选于1928年5月15日举行，是共和党为1928年美国总统选举提名候选人而在各州举行的初选之一。新泽西州各国会选区分别选出共和党全国代表大会代表，另有7名全州代表。

en.s: The 1928 New Jersey Democratic presidential primary was held on May 15, 1928, in New Jersey as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1928 United States presidential election. Delegates to the 1928 Democratic National Convention were elected from each of the state's congressional districts, along with eight delegates at-large.

zh.t: 1928年新泽西州民主党总统初选
zh.s: 1928年新泽西州民主党总统初选于1928年5月15日举行，是民主党为1928年美国总统选举提名候选人而在各州举行的初选之一。新泽西州各国会选区分别选出民主党全国代表大会代表，另有8名全州代表。

en.s: The Cleveland Clinic fire was a major structure fire at Cleveland Clinic in Cleveland, Ohio on May 15, 1929. It started in the basement of the hospital and it was caused by nitrocellulose x-ray film that ignited when an exposed light bulb was too close to the film. The fire generated poisonous gas and two separate explosions. The fire claimed 123 lives, including one of the founders, Dr. John Phillips. Policeman Ernest Staab was killed by the gas while rescuing 21 victims.

zh.s: 1929年5月15日，俄亥俄州克利夫兰的克利夫兰诊所发生严重火灾。火灾从医院地下室起，原因是硝化纤维X光胶片被点燃，起火时一只裸露灯泡离胶片太近。火灾产生有毒气体，并引发两次爆炸，共造成123人死亡，其中包括诊所创办人之一约翰·菲利普斯医生。警员欧内斯特·斯塔布在营救21名受困者时吸入毒气身亡。

en.s: The First Battle of Guilin took place on May 15, 1929, in the northern part of Guangxi, China. It was one of the civil war battles that took place inside the National Revolutionary Army. The warring parties in Guilin battle, one side is the Fourth Army of the Xiang Army, and the other is the Army of the New Guangxi Clique.

zh.s: 第一次桂林战役于1929年5月15日在中国广西北部爆发，是国民革命军内部的一场内战。桂林战役的交战双方分别是湘军第四军和新桂系部队。

en.s: On 15 May 1929 at the Estadio Metropolitano in Madrid, the home stadium of Atlético Madrid, England's national team were defeated 4–3 by Spain in a friendly international football match. As a result, Spain became the first team from Continental Europe to defeat England, and doing so in the first meeting between the two countries.

zh.s: 1929年5月15日，英格兰国家队在马德里大都会球场（马德里竞技队主场）与西班牙队进行一场国际友谊赛，最终以3比4告负。因此，西班牙成为首支击败英格兰的欧洲大陆球队；这也是两国球队首次交锋。

en.s: Inukai Tsuyoshi (Japanese: 犬養 毅, 4 June 1855 – 15 May 1932) was a Japanese statesman who served as prime minister of Japan from 1931 to his assassination in 1932. At the age of 76, Inukai was Japan's second oldest-serving prime minister, after Kantarō Suzuki whose term ended at the age of 77.

zh.s: 犬养毅（日语：犬養 毅，1855年6月4日—1932年5月15日）是日本政治家，曾于1931年至1932年担任首相，后遭刺杀身亡。犬养毅享年76岁，是日本任职年龄第二大的首相；铃木贯太郎卸任时77岁，是任职年龄最大的首相。

en.t: A self coup by prime minister Kārlis Ulmanis succeeds in Latvia, suspending its constitution and dissolving its Saeima
en.s: Kārlis Augusts Vilhelms Ulmanis (Latvian: [ˈkaːrlis ˈɑuɡusts ˈvilxɛlms ˈuɫmɑnis]; 4 September 1877 – 20 September 1942) was a Latvian politician and dictator. He was one of the most prominent Latvian politicians of pre-World War II Latvia during the Interwar period of independence from November 1918 to June 1940 and served as the country's first prime minister.

zh.t: 拉脱维亚总理卡尔利斯·乌尔马尼斯发动自我政变，暂停宪法并解散议会
zh.s: 卡尔利斯·奥古斯茨·维尔赫尔姆斯·乌尔马尼斯（拉脱维亚语发音：[ˈkaːrlis ˈɑuɡusts ˈvilxɛlms ˈuɫmɑnis]；1877年9月4日—1942年9月20日）是拉脱维亚政治家和独裁者。两次世界大战之间，拉脱维亚于1918年11月至1940年6月保持独立，他是这一时期最重要的政治人物之一，并担任该国首任总理。

en.t: Oil campaign of World War II
en.s: The Allied oil campaign of World War II was an aerial bombing campaign conducted by the RAF and the USAAF against facilities supplying Nazi Germany with petroleum, oil, and lubrication (POL) products. It formed part of the immense Allied strategic bombing effort during the war. The targets in Germany and in Axis-controlled Europe included refineries, synthetic-fuel factories, storage depots and other POL-infrastructure.

en.s: The Battle of Gembloux (or Battle of the Gembloux Gap) was fought between French and German forces in May 1940 during the Second World War. On 10 May 1940, The Wehrmacht, invaded Luxembourg, The Netherlands and Belgium under the operational plan Fall Gelb (Case Yellow). Allied armies responded with the Dyle Plan (Breda variant), intended to halt the Germans in Belgium, believing it to be the main German thrust.

zh.s: 让布卢战役又称让布卢缺口战役，是1940年5月第二次世界大战期间法国和德国军队之间的一场战斗。1940年5月10日，德意志国防军按“黄色方案”入侵卢森堡、荷兰和比利时。盟军则执行“戴尔计划”（布雷达变体），准备在比利时阻止德军，因为他们认为比利时是德军的主要进攻方向。

en.t: First flight of the Gloster E.28/39, the first British and Allied jet aircraft
en.s: The Gloster E.28/39, (also referred to as the Gloster Whittle, Gloster Pioneer, or Gloster G.40) was the first British turbojet-engined aircraft, first flying in 1941. It was the third turbojet aircraft to fly after the German Heinkel He 178 (1939) and Heinkel He 280 (1941). The E.28/39 was the product of a specification which had been issued by the Air Ministry for a suitable aircraft to test the novel jet propulsion designs that Frank Whittle had been developing during the 1930s.

zh.t: 格洛斯特E.28/39喷气式飞机首飞
zh.s: 格洛斯特E.28/39也称格洛斯特惠特尔、格洛斯特先锋或格洛斯特G.40，是英国第一架涡轮喷气式飞机，于1941年首飞。它是继德国亨克尔He 178（1939年）和He 280（1941年）之后第三架首飞的喷气式飞机。E.28/39是根据英国航空部提出的规格设计的测试机，用于测试弗兰克·惠特尔在20世纪30年代研发的新型喷气推进设计。

en.s: Operation Checkmate was the codename for a raid on shipping at Haugesund, Norway in April 1943 during the Second World War by British Commandos. The raiding party consisted of seven men of No. 14 (Arctic) Commando who managed to sink one ship using limpet mines. While waiting in hiding for the transport back to the United Kingdom they were captured on 14 and 15 May 1943 and eventually taken to Sachsenhausen and Belsen concentration camps where six of them were executed, victims of the Commando Order.

zh.t: 格斗突击队挪威突袭行动（行动代号：Checkmate）
zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，英国突击队于1943年4月在挪威海于格松袭击船只，行动代号为Checkmate。突击队由第14（北极）突击队的7名队员组成，他们用蛙人磁性水雷击沉一艘船。队员藏匿等待返回英国的交通工具时，于5月14日和15日被捕，后来被送往萨克森豪森和贝尔根-贝尔森集中营；其中6人因突击队命令而遭处决。

en.s: The 1943 Football League War Cup final was an association football match contested by Arsenal and Blackpool. The match was held at Chelsea's home stadium Stamford Bridge on 15 May 1943, with Blackpool winning 4–2. According to British sportswriter Jon Henderson, it was "widely regarded as the greatest club match" of World War II.

zh.s: 1943年足球联赛战争杯决赛由阿森纳对阵布莱克浦。比赛于1943年5月15日在切尔西主场斯坦福桥球场举行，布莱克浦以4比2获胜。英国体育记者乔恩·亨德森称，这场比赛“普遍被认为是”第二次世界大战期间最精彩的俱乐部赛事。

en.s: The Communist International (abbreviated as Comintern), also known as the Third International, was a Marxist political international that advocated world communism and existed from 1919 to 1943. Emerging from the collapse of the Second International during World War I, it was founded at a congress in Moscow convened by Vladimir Lenin and the Russian Communist Party (Bolsheviks) (RCP), which aimed to create a new international body committed to revolutionary socialism and the overthrow of capitalism worldwide.

zh.s: 共产国际也称第三国际，是一个主张世界共产主义的马克思主义国际组织，存在于1919年至1943年。它在第二国际于第一次世界大战期间瓦解后成立。列宁和俄国共产党（布尔什维克）召集代表大会，在莫斯科成立共产国际，推动世界革命社会主义和推翻资本主义。

en.s: The Battle of Poljana (Monday May 14 – Tuesday May 15, 1945) was a battle of World War II in Yugoslavia. It started at Poljana, near the village of Prevalje in Yugoslavia (now Slovenia), and was the culmination of a series of engagements between the Yugoslav Partisans and a large retreating Axis column, numbering in excess of 30,000 men. The column consisted of units of the German (Wehrmacht), the Armed Forces of the Independent State of Croatia, the Montenegrin People's Army (former Chetniks and the survivors of the Battle on Lijevče field), and Slovene Home Guard forces, as well as other fascist collaborationist factions and even civilians who were attempting to escape into British-controlled Austria.

zh.s: 波尔亚纳战役于1945年5月14日（星期一）至5月15日（星期二）在南斯拉夫爆发，是第二次世界大战期间的一场战斗。战斗始于波尔亚纳，靠近普雷瓦列村（今斯洛文尼亚），是南斯拉夫游击队与一支超过3万人的轴心国撤退部队之间一系列交战的最后一战。这支部队包括德国国防军、克罗地亚独立国武装部队、黑山人民军（前切特尼克成员及利耶夫切原野战役的幸存者）、斯洛文尼亚国土卫队，以及其他法西斯合作者团体和试图逃往英国控制区奥地利的平民。

en.t: Japanese coup d'état in French Indochina
en.s: The Japanese coup d'état in French Indochina, known as Meigō Sakusen (明号作戦, Operation Bright Moon; Chiến dịch Giăng Sáng), was a Japanese operation that took place on 9 March 1945, towards the end of World War II. With Japanese forces losing the war and the threat of an Allied invasion of Indochina imminent, the Japanese were concerned about an uprising against them by French colonial forces.

en.s: The Battle of Nirim, also Battle of Dangour, was a military engagement between the Egyptian army and the Jewish Haganah on May 15, 1948, the first day of the Egyptian invasion of Israel in the 1948 Arab–Israeli War. It was fought in kibbutz Nirim (in Arabic, Dangour), founded just two years earlier as part of the 11 points in the Negev. The Egyptian 6th Battalion attacked about 40 Israeli defenders at dawn on May 15, backed by armored vehicles, mortars, cannons and aircraft. They failed to take the village and retreated about 7 hours later, leaving behind about 30–35 dead.

zh.s: 尼里姆战役又称丹古尔战役，是1948年5月15日埃及军队与犹太复国主义武装“哈加纳”之间的一场战斗。这一天也是1948年阿以战争中埃及开始入侵以色列的第一天。战斗发生在尼里姆基布兹（阿拉伯语名为丹古尔）；该基布兹两年前刚建成，是内盖夫“11个据点”计划的一部分。黎明时分，埃及第六营在装甲车、迫击炮、火炮和飞机支援下，向约40名以方守军发起进攻。埃军未能攻下村庄，约7小时后撤退，留下约30至35具遗体。

en.s: The 1948 Arab–Israeli War (15 May 1948 – 10 March 1949), also known as the First Arab–Israeli War, followed the civil war in Mandatory Palestine (29 November 1947 – 14 May 1948) as the second and final stage of the 1948 Palestine war.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Hungary on 15 May 1949. The Hungarian Independent People's Front, an umbrella group created that February to replace the National Independence Front and led by the Hungarian Working People's Party (as the Hungarian Communist Party had been renamed following a merger with the Hungarian Social Democratic Party), but also including the remaining four non-communist parties, ran a single list of candidates espousing a common programme. With all organised opposition having been destroyed, and the Communists dropping all pretense of democracy, the Front won 95.6% of the vote, presaging the result of elections through 1990.

zh.s: 匈牙利于1949年5月15日举行议会选举。匈牙利独立人民阵线是一个伞式组织，当年2月成立以取代民族独立阵线，由匈牙利劳动人民党领导。该党由匈牙利共产党与匈牙利社会民主党合并后改名而来；阵线还包括剩余的四个非共产党政党。各党共同推出一份候选人名单和共同纲领。随着有组织的反对力量已被瓦解，共产党也不再掩饰其放弃民主的做法，人民阵线赢得95.6%的选票。此后历次选举的结果直到1990年都与此相似。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in South Korea on 15 May 1956. The result was a victory for Syngman Rhee, who won 70.0% of the vote. Voter turnout was 94.4%. Rhee, who at that time held a virtual monopoly on political power, was opposed by Shin Ik-hee and Cho Bong-am. Shin died before the election by disease, and Cho campaigned on a platform of peaceful reunification in opposition to Rhee's policy of "March North and unify Korea". Cho exceeded expectations by receiving over 30% of the vote. Three years later, Cho was accused of violating the National Security Law and executed.

zh.s: 韩国于1956年5月15日举行总统选举，李承晚以70.0%的得票率获胜，投票率为94.4%。当时李承晚几乎垄断了政治权力，主要对手是申翼熙和曹奉岩。申翼熙在选举前病逝；曹奉岩主张和平统一，与李承晚“北进统一”的政策相对。曹奉岩得票超过30%，高于外界预期。三年后，他被指违反《国家保安法》，并遭到处决。

en.s: The 1960 Coupe de France final was a football match played at Stade Olympique Yves-du-Manoir, Colombes on 15 May 1960 that saw AS Monaco FC defeat AS Saint-Étienne 4–2 thanks to goals by Serge Roy (2), Henri Biancheri and François Ludwikowski.

zh.s: 1960年法国杯决赛于1960年5月15日在科隆布的伊夫·迪马努瓦奥林匹克球场举行。摩纳哥足球俱乐部以4比2击败圣埃蒂安，进球者为塞尔日·鲁瓦（2球）、亨利·比安切里和弗朗索瓦·路德维科夫斯基。

en.s: The 1963 European Cup Winners' Cup final was the final football match of the 1962–63 European Cup Winners' Cup and was the third European Cup Winners' Cup final. It was contested between the defending champions, Atlético Madrid of Spain and Tottenham Hotspur of England, and was held at Feijenoord Stadion in Rotterdam, Netherlands. Tottenham won the match 5–1 thanks to goals by Jimmy Greaves (2), John White and Terry Dyson (2).

zh.s: 1963年欧洲优胜者杯决赛是1962—1963赛季该项赛事的决胜战，也是赛事第三届决赛。对阵双方是卫冕冠军、西班牙马德里竞技队和英格兰托特纳姆热刺队。比赛在荷兰鹿特丹的费耶诺德体育场举行，热刺以5比1获胜，进球者为吉米·格里夫斯（2球）、约翰·怀特和特里·戴森（2球）。

en.s: An indirect presidential election (officially the 6th Federal Convention) was held in West Germany on 15 May 1974. Though not term limited, incumbent Gustav Heinemann chose not to seek a second term. The government parties (SPD and FDP) nominated Vice-Chancellor Walter Scheel; the Christian Democratic Union nominated Richard von Weizsäcker. Scheel won the election by 32 votes on the first ballot. He served as president until 1979.

en.s: The 1977 WFA Cup Final was the seventh final of the FA Women's Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. en.s: The Battle of Lira was one of the last battles in the Uganda–Tanzania War, fought by Tanzania and its Uganda National Liberation Front (UNLF) allies, against Uganda Army troops loyal to Idi Amin on 15 May 1979. The Tanzanian-led forces easily routed Lira's garrison of Amin loyalists, and then intercepted and destroyed one retreating column of Uganda Army soldiers near the town.

zh.s: 利拉战役是乌干达—坦桑尼亚战争末期的战斗之一。1979年5月15日，坦桑尼亚军队及其乌干达民族解放阵线盟友，与效忠伊迪·阿明的乌干达军队在此交战。坦桑尼亚领导的部队迅速击溃利拉的阿明派驻军，随后在镇附近拦截并摧毁了一支撤退中的乌干达军队纵队。

en.s: The Len Cantello Testimonial Match, (West Bromwich Albion XI v Cyrille Regis & Laurie Cunningham XI), was a testimonial football match that took place in May 1979 to celebrate West Bromwich Albion player Len Cantello, who played for the club over 300 times between 1968 and 1979. en.s: The 1982 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Parc des Princes, Paris on 15 May 1982, that saw Paris Saint-Germain FC win their first Coupe de France by defeating AS Saint-Étienne in a penalty shoot out. en.t: 1992 Yugoslav People's Army column incident in Tuzla
en.s: The 1992 Yugoslav People's Army column incident in Tuzla, also known as Tuzla column (Serbo-Croatian: Tuzlanska kolona, Тузланска колона) was an attack on the 92nd Motorized Brigade of the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA) in the Bosnian city of Tuzla on 15 May 1992. The incident occurred at the road junction of Brčanska Malta. At least 54 soldiers of the JNA were killed and 44 wounded during the attacks.

zh.t: 1992年图兹拉南斯拉夫人民军纵队事件
zh.s: 1992年图兹拉南斯拉夫人民军纵队事件又称“图兹拉纵队事件”（塞尔维亚-克罗地亚语：Tuzlanska kolona，Тузланска колона），是1992年5月15日在波斯尼亚城市图兹拉发生的一起袭击事件。南斯拉夫人民军第92摩托化旅在布尔钱斯卡马尔塔路口遭到攻击，至少54名南斯拉夫人民军士兵死亡，44人受伤。

en.t: Kindergarten excursion bus fire in Pingzhen
en.s: A bus carrying children, teachers and parents on a kindergarten excursion caught fire in Pingzhen, Taiwan. The fire killed 23 people.

zh.t: 平镇幼儿园郊游巴士起火
zh.s: 一辆载有儿童、教师和家长的郊游巴士在台湾平镇起火，造成23人死亡。

en.s: Triplemanía II-B was a major lucha libre, or professional wrestling event Asistencia Asesoría y Administración (AAA) that took place at Estadio Olímpico Benito Juárez in Zapopan, Jalisco on May 15, 1994. The show was the second of three Triplemanía II shows held in 1994, preceded by Triplemanía II-A, with a subsequent show held in 12 days later. 1994 was the first year AAA held multiple Triplemanía shows in a year, a tradition they would continue through 1997, after which Triplemanía became a single annual event.

zh.s: Triplemanía II-B是墨西哥摔角推广公司AAA（Asistencia Asesoría y Administración）于1994年5月15日在哈利斯科州萨波潘的贝尼托·华雷斯奥林匹克体育场举办的一场重要职业摔角赛事。这是当年三场Triplemanía II赛事中的第二场，前一场为Triplemanía II-A，后一场在12天后举行。1994年是AAA首次在一年内举办多场Triplemanía，此后这一做法延续至1997年；之后Triplemanía改为每年举办一场。

The hostages were subsequently moved to Geselama. The International Committee of the Red Cross acted as an intermediary between the OPM and the Indonesian authorities.

en.s: Break The Barrier was a professional wrestling supercard held at Viking Hall, better known as the ECW Arena, in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania on May 15, 1999. The event was organized by the founders of Scoopswrestling.com, Al Isaacs, Remy Arteaga and Barbi Bistrowitz, and brought together some of the top independent wrestlers from around the country. It was one of the biggest interpromotional events in the United States and represented by 12 independent promotions including Allied Powers Wrestling Federation, Combat Zone Wrestling, Extreme Championship Wrestling, Independent Pro Wrestling, Independent Professional Wrestling Alliance, Maryland Championship Wrestling, Music City Wrestling, NWA New Jersey, New Dimension Wrestling, South's Greatest Wrestling Fans, Steel City Wrestling, World Legion Wrestling and World Wrestling Organization.

zh.s: Break the Barrier是职业摔角特别赛事，于1999年5月15日在宾夕法尼亚州费城的维京厅（即ECW竞技馆）举行。赛事由Scoopswrestling.com创办人艾尔·艾萨克斯、雷米·阿特加和芭比·比斯特罗维茨组织，汇集了全美多家独立摔角联盟的顶尖选手。它是美国规模最大的跨联盟赛事之一，共有12家独立联盟参加：Allied Powers Wrestling Federation、Combat Zone Wrestling、Extreme Championship Wrestling、Independent Pro Wrestling、Independent Professional Wrestling Alliance、Maryland Championship Wrestling、Music City Wrestling、NWA New Jersey、New Dimension Wrestling、South's Greatest Wrestling Fans、Steel City Wrestling、World Legion Wrestling和World Wrestling Organization。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Slovakia on 15 May 1999, with a second round on 29 May. Following a constitutional amendment in 1998 that introduced direct presidential elections for the first time, they resulted in a victory for Rudolf Schuster, who received 57.2% of the vote in the run-off.

en.s: General elections were held in Fiji between 8 and 15 May 1999. They were the first election held under the revised Constitution of 1997, which instituted a new electoral system and resulted in Mahendra Chaudhry taking office as Fiji's first Indo-Fijian Prime Minister.

zh.s: 斐济于1999年5月8日至15日举行大选。这是1997年修订宪法后首次举行的选举，新宪法设立了新的选举制度。选举后，马亨德拉·乔杜里出任斐济首位印裔总理。

en.s: Chief Executive elections were held in Macau on 15 May 1999 to elect the first Chief Executive (CE), the highest office of the Macau Special Administrative Region, before Macau was due to be handed back to China by Portugal. Edmund Ho was elected as the first leader of the Macau SAR. This was the only contested Chief Executive election to date.

zh.s: 澳门于1999年5月15日举行行政长官选举，选出澳门特别行政区首任行政长官。澳门当时即将由葡萄牙移交中国。何厚铧当选澳门特别行政区首任行政长官。这是迄今唯一一次有竞争的行政长官选举。

en.s: The 1999 FA Trophy final was an association football match played on 15 May 1999 at Wembley Stadium, London. The match was the 30th final of the FA Trophy, the domestic cup competition played primarily by semi-professional teams in the English football league system. The final was contested between Conference National members Forest Green Rovers and Kingstonian. Both clubs were competing in their first FA Trophy final.

zh.s: 1999年英格兰足总锦标赛决赛于1999年5月15日在伦敦温布利球场举行。这是该项国内杯赛的第30届决赛，参赛者主要是英格兰足球联赛体系中的半职业球队。对阵双方是英格兰足球议会全国联赛成员福里斯特格林流浪者队和金斯顿人队；两队此前都未参加过足总锦标赛决赛。

en.s: The 1999 Coupe de France final was a football match held at Stade de France, Saint-Denis on 15 May 1999 that saw FC Nantes Atlantique defeat CS Sedan Ardennes from Division 2 1–0 thanks to a goal by Olivier Monterrubio.

zh.s: 1999年法国杯决赛于1999年5月15日在圣但尼法兰西体育场举行。南特大西洋足球俱乐部以1比0击败当时参加乙级联赛的色当阿登足球俱乐部，奥利维耶·蒙特鲁比奥打入全场唯一进球。

en.t: A CSX EMD SD40-2 8888 rolls out of a train yard in Walbridge, Ohio, with 47 freight cars, including some tank cars with flammable chemical, after its engineer fails to reboard it after setting a yard switch. It travels south driverless for 66 miles (106 km) until it is brought to a halt near Kenton. The incident became the inspiration for the 2010 film Unstoppable
en.s: The EMD SD40-2 is a 3,000-horsepower (2,200 kW) C-C diesel–electric locomotive built by EMD from 1972 to 1997. The SD40-2 was introduced in January 1972 as part of EMD's Dash 2 series, competing against the GE U30C. Although higher-horsepower locomotives were available, including EMD's own SD45-2, the reliability and versatility of the 3,000-horsepower (2,200 kW) SD40-2 made it one of the best-selling models in EMD's history, edged out only by the GP9, and was the standard of the industry for several decades after its introduction.

zh.t: CSX 8888号机车在工程师未能重新登车后，载着47节货车无人驾驶行驶66英里，事件启发了电影《危情时速》
zh.s: EMD SD40-2是一款由EMD于1972年至1997年生产的3000马力（2200千瓦）C-C轴式柴油电力机车。该型号于1972年1月作为EMD Dash 2系列的一员推出，与GE U30C竞争。虽然当时已有更大功率的机车，包括EMD自家的SD45-2，但3000马力（2200千瓦）的SD40-2可靠且用途广泛，成为EMD历史上最畅销的车型之一，仅次于GP9。自问世后的数十年间，它一直是行业标准车型。

en.s: The 2002 UEFA Champions League final was the final match of the 2001–02 UEFA Champions League, Europe's primary club football competition. The show-piece event was contested between Bayer Leverkusen of Germany and Real Madrid of Spain at Hampden Park in Glasgow, Scotland, on 15 May 2002 to decide the winner of the Champions League. Leverkusen appeared in the final for the first time, whereas Real Madrid appeared in their 12th final.

zh.s: 2002年欧洲冠军联赛决赛是2001—2002赛季欧洲冠军联赛的决胜战。该赛事是欧洲顶级俱乐部足球赛事。决赛于2002年5月15日在苏格兰格拉斯哥的汉普顿公园球场举行，由德国勒沃库森队对阵西班牙皇家马德里队，争夺冠军。勒沃库森首次闯入决赛，皇家马德里则是第12次进入决赛。

en.s: The 2002 Bulgarian Cup final was played at the Stadion Slavia in Sofia on 15 May 2002 and was contested between the sides of CSKA Sofia and Levski Sofia. The match was won by Levski Sofia.

zh.s: 2002年保加利亚杯决赛于2002年5月15日在索菲亚的斯拉维亚体育场举行，由索菲亚中央陆军队对阵索菲亚列夫斯基队。最终列夫斯基队获胜。

en.s: The 55th Cannes Film Festival took place from 15 to 26 May 2002. American filmmaker David Lynch served as jury president for the main competition. Virginie Ledoyen hosted the opening and closing ceremonies. French-Polish filmmaker Roman Polanski won the Palme d'Or, the festival's top prize, for the drama film The Pianist.

en.s: The Zagreb local elections of 2005 were held on 15 May 2005 in Zagreb, the capital of Croatia. On the last local elections, in 2001, Milan Bandić had been re-elected as the mayor of Zagreb. However, a 2002 incident made him resign in favor of Vlasta Pavić, a deputy mayor chosen by Social Democratic Party, Bandić's party. Pavić remained formally in control of the city until 2005. However, she was moved down the list of candidates to the 16th place, returning the local candidacy to Milan Bandić.

zh.s: 2005年萨格勒布地方选举于5月15日在克罗地亚首都萨格勒布举行。米兰·班迪奇在2001年地方选举中再次当选市长。2002年发生的一起事件促使他辞职，由副市长弗拉斯塔·帕维奇接任；帕维奇由班迪奇所属的社会民主党选出。帕维奇一直名义上掌管市政事务，直到2005年。后来她在候选人名单上的排名被降至第16位，地方选举候选人因此重新换成班迪奇。

en.s: Local elections were held in Croatia on 15 May 2005. This were the fourth local elections in Croatia since independence. Voting at 6,589 separate polling stations across Croatia for members of representative bodies of local and regional self-government units, the citizens elected members for a total of 426 municipal and 123 city councils, as well as members for 20 county assemblies, and the Zagreb City Assembly.

zh.s: 克罗地亚于2005年5月15日举行地方选举，这是该国独立后第四次地方选举。全国6589个投票站开放投票，选民选出地方和地区自治单位的代表机构成员，包括426个市镇议会、123个城市议会、20个县议会以及萨格勒布市议会议员。

en.s: The 2005 Hard Justice was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on May 15, 2005, at the TNA Impact! Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the first event under the Hard Justice chronology and the fifth event in the 2005 TNA PPV schedule. Eight matches and one pre-show match were featured on the event's card.

en.s: The 2009–10 DFB-Pokal season came to a close on 15 May 2010 when Bayern Munich played defending champions Werder Bremen at the Olympiastadion in Berlin. Bayern thrashed Bremen 4-0 with goals from Robben, Olić, Ribéry, and Schweinsteiger. The title capped off a successful season, with Bayern winning the domestic double of the Fußball-Bundesliga and the DFB-Pokal. These successes were Bayern's 22nd league and 15th cup titles.

zh.s: 2009—2010赛季德国杯于2010年5月15日落幕。拜仁慕尼黑在柏林奥林匹克体育场迎战卫冕冠军云达不来梅，并以4比0大胜，罗本、奥利奇、里贝里和施魏因施泰格各入一球。拜仁凭此夺得国内双冠王，同时赢得队史第22个联赛冠军和第15个德国杯冠军。

en.s: The 2010 Scottish Cup Final was the 125th final of Scotland's most prestigious football knockout competition, the Scottish Cup. The match took place on 15 May 2010, at Hampden Park, Glasgow and was contested by first time finalists Ross County and 1994 winners Dundee United. Craig Conway scored a brace as Dundee United ended a wait of 16 years to win the Scottish Cup for the second time in the club's history.

zh.s: 2010年苏格兰杯决赛是苏格兰最重要的足球淘汰赛——苏格兰杯的第125届决赛。比赛于2010年5月15日在格拉斯哥汉普顿公园球场举行，对阵双方是首次进入决赛的罗斯郡队和曾于1994年夺冠的邓迪联队。克雷格·康威梅开二度，帮助邓迪联队结束长达16年的等待，第二次赢得苏格兰杯。

en.s: The 2010 FA Cup final was the 129th final of the FA Cup, the world's oldest domestic football cup competition. The match took place on 15 May 2010, at Wembley Stadium, London, in front of a crowd of over 88,000 and a British television audience of over 5 million. The match was contested between the two most recent FA Cup winners, Chelsea (2009, also cup holders) and Portsmouth (2008), and was refereed by Chris Foy from Merseyside.

zh.s: 2010年英格兰足总杯决赛是足总杯第129届决赛。足总杯是世界上历史最悠久的国内足球杯赛。比赛于2010年5月15日在伦敦温布利球场举行，现场观众超过88,000人，英国电视观众超过500万人。对阵双方是最近两届冠军：2009年冠军、卫冕队切尔西和2008年冠军朴茨茅斯。裁判是来自默西塞德郡的克里斯·福伊。

en.s: The 2010 Belgian Cup final, named Cofidis Cup after the sponsor, was played on 15 May 2010 between Gent and Cercle Brugge. It was the 55th Belgian Cup final. Gent won the match 3–0 for their third title.

zh.s: 2010年比利时杯决赛因赞助冠名为Cofidis杯，于2010年5月15日举行，由根特队对阵色克尔布鲁日队。这是比利时杯第55届决赛。根特队以3比0获胜，第三次夺冠。

en.s: The 2010 Netball Superleague Grand Final featured Team Bath and Hertfordshire Mavericks. Having previously played each other in the 2006, 2007 and 2008 grand finals, this was the fourth final that featured Team Bath and Mavericks. Just like the three previous encounters, it was Team Bath that emerged as winners. Mavericks won the first quarter and remained competitive throughout the whole match.

zh.t: 2010年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛
zh.s: 2010年无挡板篮球超级联赛总决赛由巴斯队对阵赫特福德郡小马队。两队此前曾在2006、2007和2008年的总决赛中交手，这是双方第四次在决赛相遇。和前三次一样，巴斯队再次夺冠。小马队赢下第一节，整场比赛也一直有竞争力。

en.s: Sacrifice (2011) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on May 15, 2011 at the Impact Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the seventh Sacrifice event. The event was notable for the return of Chyna to in-ring competition for the first time since 2002; however, it would ultimately be her last match.

zh.s: 《Sacrifice》（2011）是职业摔角付费点播赛事，由全面不间断动作摔角（TNA）推广公司制作，于2011年5月15日在佛罗里达州奥兰多的Impact Zone举行。这是第七届Sacrifice赛事。赛事的一大看点是Chyna自2002年以来首次重返擂台比赛，但这最终也成为她的最后一场比赛。

en.s: The Battle of Misrata (Arabic: معركة مصراتة), also known as the Siege of Misrata, was a battle of the First Libyan Civil War for the control of Misrata. It was fought between troops loyal to the government of Muammar Gaddafi, and anti-Gaddafi rebels who held Misrata, the third largest city in Libya.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 米苏拉塔战役（阿拉伯语：معركة مصراتة）又称米苏拉塔围城战，是2011年利比亚第一次内战中为争夺米苏拉塔控制权而发生的战斗。交战双方是效忠穆阿迈尔·卡扎菲政府的军队，以及控制米苏拉塔的反卡扎菲叛军。米苏拉塔是利比亚第三大城市。

en.s: The 2012 Portland City Commission elections were held on May 15, 2012, and November 6, 2012. Steve Novick won position 4 outright by receiving over 50% of the vote and avoided a runoff. Amanda Fritz won election to position 1 during the runoff election.

zh.s: 波特兰市委员会选举于2012年5月15日和11月6日举行。史蒂夫·诺维克在第4席选举中得票超过50%，直接当选，无需参加第二轮投票。阿曼达·弗里茨则在第二轮投票中当选第1席。

en.s: The 2013 UEFA Europa League final was the final match of the 2012–13 UEFA Europa League, the 42nd season of Europe's secondary club football tournament organised by UEFA, and the 4th season since it was renamed from the UEFA Cup to the UEFA Europa League. The match was played at the Amsterdam Arena in Amsterdam, Netherlands, on 15 May 2013, between Portuguese side Benfica and English side Chelsea.

zh.s: 2013年欧洲联赛决赛是2012—2013赛季欧洲联赛的决胜战。这是由欧足联主办的欧洲次级俱乐部足球赛事第42个赛季，也是赛事从“欧洲联盟杯”更名为“欧洲联赛”后的第4个赛季。比赛于2013年5月15日在荷兰阿姆斯特丹竞技场举行，由葡萄牙本菲卡队对阵英格兰切尔西队。

en.s: The 2013 Bali gubernatorial election was a regional head election in Indonesia held on May 15 2013 to elect the governor and vice governor of Bali for the five-year term (2013–2018). Incumbent governor I Made Mangku Pastika of the Democratic Party won this election defeating Anak Agung Gede Ngurah Puspayoga of the Indonesian Democratic Party of Struggle (PDI-P).

zh.s: 印度尼西亚巴厘岛于2013年5月15日举行地方首长选举，选出任期为2013年至2018年的省长和副省长。时任省长、民主党成员伊·马德·曼库·帕斯蒂卡获胜，击败了印度尼西亚斗争民主党候选人阿纳克·阿贡·格德·恩古拉·普斯帕约加。

en.s: The 2013 Bulgarian Cup final was the 73rd final of the Bulgarian Cup, and was contested between Beroe Stara Zagora and Levski Sofia on 15 May 2013. The match finished in a 3–3 draw, but Beroe clinched their second ever Bulgarian Cup title by winning 3–1 on penalties.

zh.s: 2013年保加利亚杯决赛是第73届赛事决赛，由旧扎戈拉贝罗队对阵索菲亚列夫斯基队。比赛于2013年5月15日举行，双方以3比3战平。贝罗队随后在点球大战中以3比1获胜，队史第二次夺得保加利亚杯。

en.s: From 15 to 21 May 2013, a series of deadly bombings and shootings struck the central and northern parts of Iraq, with a few incidents occurring in towns in the south and far west as well. The attacks killed at least 449 people and left 732 others injured in one of the deadliest outbreaks of violence in years.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2013年5月15日至21日，伊拉克中部和北部发生一系列致命爆炸和枪击，南部和最西部的少数城镇也发生袭击。这轮暴力事件造成至少449人死亡、732人受伤，是多年来最严重的一次。

en.s: The 66th Cannes Film Festival took place from 15 to 26 May 2013. American filmmaker Steven Spielberg was the Jury President for the main competition. The French film Blue Is the Warmest Colour won the Palme d'Or. In an unprecedented move, along with the director, Abdellatif Kechiche, the Jury decided to take "the exceptional step" of awarding the film's two main actresses, Adèle Exarchopoulos and Léa Seydoux, with the Palme.

zh.s: 第66届戛纳电影节于2013年5月15日至26日举行。美国电影人史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格担任主竞赛单元评审团主席。法国电影《阿黛尔的生活》获得金棕榈奖。评审团打破惯例，决定将这一奖项同时授予导演阿卜杜勒-拉蒂夫·科奇切和影片两位主演阿黛尔·艾克阿切波洛斯、蕾雅·赛杜，并称这是一次“特别的决定”。

en.s: The 2014 Bulgarian Cup final was the 74th final of the Bulgarian Cup. The match, contested by Botev Plovdiv and Ludogorets Razgrad, took place on 15 May 2014 at Lazur Stadium in Burgas. Ludogorets won the final 1–0, claiming their second ever Bulgarian Cup title.

zh.s: 2014年保加利亚杯决赛是该赛事第74届决赛，由普罗夫迪夫博特夫队对阵拉兹格勒卢多戈雷茨队。比赛于2014年5月15日在布尔加斯的拉祖尔体育场举行。卢多戈雷茨以1比0获胜，第二次夺得保加利亚杯。

en.s: The 2014 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that was played on 15 May 2014 in Poltava. The match was the 23rd Ukrainian Cup Final and was contested by Cup holders Shakhtar Donetsk and Dynamo Kyiv.

zh.s: 2014年乌克兰杯决赛于2014年5月15日在波尔塔瓦举行，是该赛事第23届决赛。对阵双方是卫冕冠军顿涅茨克矿工队和基辅迪纳摩队。

en.s: The 2014 Danish Cup final was a football match that decided the winner of the 2013–14 Danish Cup. It was played on 15 May 2014 at 20:00 CEST.

zh.s: 2014年丹麦杯决赛决出了2013—2014赛季丹麦杯冠军。比赛于2014年5月15日欧洲中部夏令时间20时举行。

en.t: May 2015 U.S. special forces raid in Syria
en.s: On 15 May 2015, 1st SFOD-Delta operators from the Joint Special Operations Command based in Iraq conducted an operation in Al-Amr, Syria to capture a senior Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL) leader named Abu Sayyaf, resulting in his death when he engaged United States forces in combat, after his location was confirmed by surveillance from British SAS operators. Abu Sayyaf role in ISIL was managing its gas and oil operations; he had built up a network of traders and wholesalers of ISIL-controlled oil that he helped triple energy revenues for the terror group.

zh.t: 2015年5月美军特种部队突袭叙利亚
zh.s: 2015年5月15日，驻伊拉克的联合特种作战司令部派出三角洲部队（第1特种部队作战分遣队）人员，在叙利亚阿尔阿姆尔展开行动，试图抓捕“伊拉克和黎凡特伊斯兰国”（ISIL）一名高级头目阿布·萨亚夫。英国特别空勤团（SAS）人员通过监视确认其位置。阿布·萨亚夫与美军交火时身亡。他在ISIL负责天然气和石油业务，建立了一个由商人和批发商组成的网络，帮助该组织将能源收入提高了两倍。

en.s: The Leyenda de Plata (2015) was professional wrestling tournament produced by the Mexican wrestling promotion Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLLl; Spanish "World Wrestling Council") that ran from May 15, 2015, over the course of two of CMLL's Friday night shows in Arena México with the finals on May 22, 2015. The annual Leyenda de Plata tournament is held in honor of lucha libre legend El Santo and is one of CMLL's most important annual tournaments.

zh.s: 2015年银色传奇杯是墨西哥摔角联盟世界摔角理事会（CMLL）举办的职业摔角赛事。比赛从2015年5月15日开始，在墨西哥竞技场举行的两场周五晚间赛事中进行，决赛于5月22日举行。银色传奇杯每年举办一次，以纪念摔角传奇人物埃尔·桑托，是CMLL最重要的年度赛事之一。

en.s: The 2015 Parti Québécois leadership election was held from May 13 to May 15, 2015 as a result of the resignation of Parti Québécois leader Pauline Marois after the defeat of her government in the April 7, 2014 provincial election.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 魁北克人党于2015年5月13日至15日举行党魁选举。此前，该党党魁保利娜·马鲁瓦在2014年4月7日省选中失利后辞职。

en.s: On 13 May 2015, army general Godefroid Niyombare said that he was "dismissing President Pierre Nkurunziza" following the 2015 Burundian unrest. However, the presidency tweeted that the "situation is under control" and there is "no coup". President Nkurunziza was at the time in neighbouring Tanzania attending the 13th Extraordinary Summit of the East African Community Heads of State, which had been convened to discuss the situation in Burundi.

zh.s: 2015年5月13日，军方将领戈德弗瓦·尼永巴雷在2015年布隆迪动乱后宣布“解除皮埃尔·恩库伦齐扎总统的职务”。但总统府在社交媒体上表示“局势已得到控制”，并称“没有发生政变”。当时恩库伦齐扎总统正在邻国坦桑尼亚，参加为讨论布隆迪局势而召开的东非共同体国家元首第13次特别峰会。

en.s: General elections were held in Dominican Republic on 15 May 2016 to elect a president, vice-president and the National Congress, as well as 20 deputies to the Central American Parliament, municipal councils, mayors and vice mayors. On 15 May 2015 Roberto Rosario, president of the Central Electoral Board, said that there would be about 4,300 seats up for election in the "most complex elections in history".

zh.s: 多米尼加共和国于2016年5月15日举行大选，选举总统、副总统、国民议会议员、20名中美洲议会议员，以及市议会成员、市长和副市长。中选委主席罗伯托·罗萨里奥于2015年5月15日表示，这次选举将有约4300个职位待选，堪称“历史上最复杂的选举”。

en.s: The 2016 National League play-off final, known as the 2016 Vanarama National League Promotion Final for sponsorship purposes, was an association football match between Forest Green Rovers and Grimsby Town on 15 May 2016 at Wembley Stadium in London. It was the 14th National League play-off final, the first under the name National League and the ninth to be played at Wembley.

zh.t: 2016年全国联赛升级附加赛决赛
zh.s: 2016年全国联赛升级附加赛决赛因赞助原因称为2016年Vanarama全国联赛升级决赛。比赛于2016年5月15日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由福里斯特格林流浪者队对阵格里姆斯比镇队。这是第14届全国联赛升级附加赛决赛，也是赛事首次以“全国联赛”之名举办，并且第九次在温布利举行。

en.s: The 2018 Khulna City Corporation election was a local government election in the city of Khulna, Bangladesh, held on 15 May 2018 to elect the Mayor of Khulna and the Khulna City Council. The election resulted in a victory for the Awami League candidate Talukder Abdul Khaleque, who was elected to a second term as mayor of the Khulna City Corporation.

zh.s: 2018年库尔纳市政公司选举于2018年5月15日在孟加拉国库尔纳市举行，选出库尔纳市长和市议会议员。人民联盟候选人塔卢克德·阿卜杜勒·哈利克获胜，第二次当选库尔纳市政公司市长。

en.s: The 2018 Oregon Commissioner of Labor and Industries election was held on May 15, 2018, in order to elect the Oregon Commissioner of Labor and Industries. The election was held on a nonpartisan basis. Incumbent Commissioner Brad Avakian did not seek reelection. Val Hoyle was elected to succeed him. Because Hoyle won a majority in the May primary election, a November runoff did not occur.

zh.t: 2018年俄勒冈州劳工与工业事务专员选举
zh.s: 俄勒冈州于2018年5月15日举行劳工与工业事务专员选举，选出该州劳工与工业事务专员。选举不以党派为基础。时任专员布拉德·阿瓦基安没有寻求连任，瓦尔·霍伊尔当选接替他。由于霍伊尔在5月初选中获得过半选票，11月无需举行第二轮投票。

en.s: The 2018 Egypt Cup final was the final match of the 2017–18 Egypt Cup and the 86th final of the Egypt Cup, Africa's oldest football cup competition. It was held at Borg El Arab Stadium in Alexandria, Egypt. It was played on 15 May 2018 between Smouha and Zamalek. It was a repeat of the 2014 final, which Zamalek won 1–0.

zh.s: 2018年埃及杯决赛是2017—2018赛季埃及杯的决胜战，也是这项非洲历史最悠久足球杯赛的第86届决赛。比赛于2018年5月15日在埃及亚历山大的博格阿拉伯体育场举行，由史莫哈队对阵扎马雷克队。这是两队继2014年决赛之后再次交锋，当时扎马雷克以1比0获胜。

en.s: The 2018 Portland City Commission elections were held on May 15, 2018, and November 6, 2018. 2 positions were up for election, Position 2 and Position 3, respectively.

zh.s: 波特兰市委员会选举于2018年5月15日和11月6日举行。第2席和第3席共两个职位分别在这两次选举中改选。

en.s: The 2019 Bulgarian Cup final was the final match of the 2018–19 Bulgarian Cup and the 79th final of the Bulgarian Cup. The final took place on 15 May 2019 at Vasil Levski National Stadium, Sofia, Bulgaria. It was refereed by Nikolay Yordanov from Sofia. The clubs contesting the final were Botev Plovdiv and Lokomotiv Plovdiv, who traditionally take part in the Plovdiv derby.

zh.s: 2019年保加利亚杯决赛是2018—2019赛季保加利亚杯的决胜战，也是赛事第79届决赛。比赛于2019年5月15日在保加利亚索菲亚的瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行，裁判为来自索菲亚的尼古拉伊·约尔丹诺夫。对阵双方是普罗夫迪夫博特夫队和普罗夫迪夫火车头队，两队之间的比赛通常被称为“普罗夫迪夫德比”。

en.s: The 2019 Israel State Cup final decided the winner of the 2018–19 Israel State Cup, the 83rd season of Israel's main football cup. It was played on 15 May 2019 at the Sammy Ofer Stadium in Haifa, between Maccabi Netanya and Bnei Yehuda. Bnei Yehuda defeated Maccabi Netanya 5–4 on penalties.

zh.s: 2019年以色列国家杯决赛决出了2018—2019赛季该国主要足球杯赛、也是第83届赛事的冠军。比赛于2019年5月15日在海法的萨米·奥费尔体育场举行，由内坦亚马卡比队对阵Bnei Yehuda队。耶胡达 בני队在点球大战中以5比4击败内坦亚马卡比队。

en.s: The 2019 Ukrainian Cup final was a football match that was played on 15 May 2019 in Zaporizhzhia between Shakhtar Donetsk and Inhulets Petrove. The match was the 28th Ukrainian Cup Final since the fall of the Soviet Union. It was the first time the cup final was held in Zaporizhzhia. Slavutych Arena, where the match was played, had previously hosted the 2010 Ukrainian Super Cup.

zh.s: 2019年乌克兰杯决赛于2019年5月15日在扎波罗热举行，对阵双方是顿涅茨克矿工队和因胡莱茨彼得罗韦队。这是苏联解体后第28届乌克兰杯决赛，也是杯赛决赛首次在扎波罗热举行。比赛在斯拉武季奇竞技场进行；该球场此前曾承办2010年乌克兰超级杯。

en.s: The 2019 Coppa Italia final decided the winner of the 2018–19 Coppa Italia, Italy's main football cup. It was played on 15 May 2019 at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome between Atalanta and Lazio. This was the first-ever meeting between these two clubs in the final. Lazio won the match 2–0, winning their seventh title overall, from 10 finals appearances.

zh.s: 2019年意大利杯决赛决出了2018—2019赛季意大利主要足球杯赛的冠军。比赛于2019年5月15日在罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，由亚特兰大队对阵拉齐奥队。这是两队首次在决赛中相遇。拉齐奥以2比0获胜，队史第10次进入决赛，并夺得第7个冠军。

en.s: The 2021 FA Cup final was an association football match played between Chelsea and Leicester City at Wembley Stadium, London, England on 15 May 2021. Organised by the Football Association (FA), it was the 140th final of the Football Association Challenge Cup (FA Cup) and the showpiece match of English football's primary cup competition.

zh.s: 2021年英格兰足总杯决赛于2021年5月15日在英格兰伦敦温布利球场举行，由切尔西对阵莱斯特城。赛事由英格兰足球总会（FA）主办，这是英格兰足球挑战杯（足总杯）的第140届决赛，也是英格兰顶级杯赛的决胜战。

en.s: UFC 262: Oliveira vs. Chandler was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on May 15, 2021, at the Toyota Center in Houston, Texas, United States.

zh.s: UFC 262：奥利维拉对阵钱德勒是一场综合格斗赛事，由终极格斗冠军赛主办，于2021年5月15日在美国德克萨斯州休斯敦的丰田中心举行。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Somalia in 15 May 2022. The election was held indirectly and after the elections for the House of the People, which began on 1 November 2021 and ended on 13 April 2022. The elections were first scheduled to end on 24 December 2021. By 25 December, only 24 of 275 representatives had been elected and the ongoing political crisis further complicated matters.

zh.s: 索马里于2022年5月15日举行间接总统选举。此前，人民院选举于2021年11月1日开始、2022年4月13日结束。总统选举原定于2021年12月24日结束，但截至12月25日，275名议员中仅有24人当选。持续的政治危机进一步增加了选举难度。

en.t: 2022 Lebanese general election in Beirut I
en.s: Voting to elect eight members of the Lebanese parliament took place in the Beirut I district (one of two electoral districts in the city) on 15 May 2022, part of the general election of that year. The constituency had 134,886 registered voters out of whom 48,311 voted.

zh.s: 2022年5月15日，黎巴嫩贝鲁特一区（该市两个选区之一）举行投票，选出8名议员。这是当年全国大选的一部分。该选区登记选民134,886人，其中48,311人参加投票。

loc: 德国北莱茵-威斯特法伦州

en.s: The 2022 North Rhine-Westphalia state election was held on 15 May 2022 to elect the 18th Landtag of North Rhine-Westphalia. The outgoing government (First Wüst cabinet) was a coalition of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU) and Free Democratic Party (FDP) led by Minister-President Hendrik Wüst. The CDU remained the largest party with 36% of votes, a small increase from 2017, while the opposition Social Democratic Party (SPD) declined to 27%.

zh.t: 2022年北莱茵-威斯特法伦州选举
zh.s: 北莱茵-威斯特法伦州于2022年5月15日举行州议会选举，选出第18届州议会。即将卸任的第一届维斯特内阁由基民盟和自民党组成，由州长亨德里克·维斯特领导。基民盟仍是最大党，得票率为36%，比2017年略有上升；反对党社民党得票率降至27%。

en.s: The 2022 Women's FA Cup final was the 52nd final of the Women's FA Cup, England's primary cup competition for women's football teams. The showpiece event was the 28th to be played directly under the auspices of The Football Association (FA) and was named the Vitality Women's FA Cup Final due to sponsorship reasons. The final was contested between Chelsea and Manchester City on 15 May 2022 at Wembley Stadium in London and broadcast on BBC1.

zh.s: 2022年女子足总杯决赛是英格兰女子足球杯赛第52届决赛。赛事由英格兰足球总会直接管理的决赛共举办了28届；因赞助原因，本场称为Vitality女子足总杯决赛。切尔西队与曼城队于2022年5月15日在伦敦温布利球场争夺冠军，比赛由BBC One转播。

en.s: Internal party elections took place within SYRIZA-PS on 15 May 2022, in which the president and the members of the Central Committee were directly elected by the members of the party.

zh.s: 激进左翼联盟—进步联盟（SYRIZA-PS）于2022年5月15日举行党内选举，由党员直接选举党主席和中央委员会成员。

en.s: The 2022 Bulgarian Cup final was the final match of the 2021–22 Bulgarian Cup and the 82nd final of the Bulgarian Cup. The final originally should have been on 11 May 2022 at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. On 28 April the date has been confirmed, but on the next day the Bulgarian Professional Football League and the Bulgarian Football Union announced a revised schedule, in which the game was set for 15 May 2022.

zh.s: 2022年保加利亚杯决赛是2021—2022赛季赛事的决胜战，也是保加利亚杯第82届决赛。比赛原定于2022年5月11日在索菲亚瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行。4月28日，日期和场地得到确认；但次日，保加利亚职业足球联赛和保加利亚足球联盟公布了修订后的赛程，将比赛改到5月15日。

en.s: The 2024 Magyar Kupa final decided the winners of the 2023–24 Magyar Kupa, the 84th season of Hungarian premier football cup, the Magyar Kupa. The match was played on 15 May 2024 at the Puskás Aréna in Budapest between Paks and Ferencváros. Paks had won the match 2–0 after extra time, securing the Magyar Kupa for the first time in their history.

zh.s: 2024年匈牙利杯决赛决出了2023—2024赛季匈牙利顶级足球杯赛——匈牙利杯的冠军，这也是该赛事第84个赛季。比赛于2024年5月15日在布达佩斯普斯卡什竞技场举行，由保克什队对阵费伦茨瓦罗斯队。保克什队在加时赛后以2比0获胜，队史首次夺得匈牙利杯。

en.s: On 15 May 2024, Prime Minister of Slovakia Robert Fico was shot and critically injured in the central Slovak town of Handlová, in front of its House of Culture after a government meeting. He was hospitalised and stabilised after emergency surgery. The perpetrator, 71-year-old Juraj Cintula, was detained by police at the scene.

zh.t: 罗伯特·菲佐遇刺未遂案
zh.s: 2024年5月15日，斯洛伐克总理罗伯特·菲佐在该国中部城镇汉德洛瓦遭枪击，伤势危重。枪击发生在一次政府会议后，他当时位于当地文化宫外。菲佐接受紧急手术后住院治疗，情况稳定。警方当场拘捕了71岁的枪手尤拉伊·琴图拉。

en.s: The 2024 Bulgarian Cup final was the final match of the 2023–24 Bulgarian Cup and the 84th final of the Bulgarian Cup. The final took place on 15 May 2024 at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia. On 2 May the date and venue has been confirmed. The clubs contesting the final were Ludogorets Razgrad and Botev Plovdiv.

zh.s: 2024年保加利亚杯决赛是2023—2024赛季保加利亚杯的决胜战，也是该赛事第84届决赛。比赛于2024年5月15日在索菲亚的瓦西尔·列夫斯基国家体育场举行。5月2日，官方确认了比赛日期和场地。对阵双方是拉兹格勒卢多戈雷茨队和普罗夫迪夫博特夫队。

en.s: The 2024 Coppa Italia final was the final match of the 2023–24 edition of the Coppa Italia, Italy's premier national football cup. It was played on 15 May 2024 between Atalanta and Juventus. Juventus won the match 1–0 for a record-extending 15th Coppa Italia title.

zh.s: 2024年意大利杯决赛决出了2023—2024赛季意大利顶级国内足球杯赛的冠军。比赛于2024年5月15日举行，由亚特兰大队对阵尤文图斯队。尤文图斯以1比0获胜，创纪录地第15次夺得意大利杯。

en.s: The 2024 Ukrainian Cup final was the 31st final match of the annual Ukrainian football cup competition. It was played on 15 May 2024 at the Avanhard Stadium in Rivne. This is the first time the cup final would be held in Rivne. With still ongoing full-scale invasion of Ukraine by the Russian Federation, this final was the first one since the start of the invasion in February 2022 and the 9th since the start of the war in 2014.

zh.s: 2024年乌克兰杯决赛是乌克兰年度足球杯赛的第31届决赛，于2024年5月15日在罗夫诺的先锋体育场举行。这是杯赛决赛首次在罗夫诺举行。由于俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰的战争仍在持续，这是自2022年2月入侵开始后首次举行的决赛，也是自2014年战争开始以来的第9届决赛。

en.s: The 2024 Cupa României final was the final match of the 2023–24 Cupa României and the 86th final of the Cupa României, Romania's premier football cup competition.

zh.s: 2024年罗马尼亚杯决赛是2023—24赛季罗马尼亚杯的决赛，也是该项罗马尼亚顶级足球杯赛的第86届决赛。

en.s: The 2025 Australian Greens leadership election was held on 15 May 2025 to elect the leader of the Australian Greens. Larissa Waters was elected unopposed to replace Adam Bandt, who resigned the leadership after losing his seat of Melbourne at the 2025 federal election. Mehreen Faruqi was re-elected deputy leader after defeating Dorinda Cox nine votes to three. The Greens hold an automatic leadership election following every federal election.

zh.s: 澳大利亚绿党于2025年5月15日举行党魁选举。拉里萨·沃特斯在无人竞争的情况下当选，接替因在2025年联邦大选中失去墨尔本选区席位而辞职的亚当·班特。梅赫林·法鲁奇以9票对3票击败多琳达·考克斯，再次当选副党魁。每次联邦大选后，绿党都会自动举行党魁选举。
